note: Today's Oxford Terrace is the plate's narrow (about 35 px) N-S 'Terrace' (first word not legible) between Prospect and Hosea Avenue; it ends in a T on the north side of Hosea Avenue. The L-shaped street continues as 'Prospect' west to Brookline Avenue.

same_names_elsewhere.note: The other end of the same L-shaped street ('Terrace') meets Hosea Avenue, not Brookline.

note: Today's Oxford Terrace is printed 'Prospect' (perhaps with a small 'Av.'); it runs east from Brookline Avenue's east side, then turns south as 'Terrace' at about x 8260, y 3010. Brookline is wide and slants NNW-SSE here, and its east edge kinks at the junction.

same_names_elsewhere.note: Curved 'Evanswood Place' bends into the E-W street printed 'Evanswood'. This is the junction nearest the expected point, but no Morrison name is printed here.

note: Morrison Place is not printed. I take it to be the narrow (about 33 ft) N-S street printed only 'St.' at x about 2297, because it lines up with the N-S avenue south of Ludlow (Morrison Avenue, x about 2300). The curved 'Evanswood Place' leaves that street in a T at y about 1538, about 400 px north of the expected point. Near the expected point there are only lots (18, 45, 44), a dashed 12-in sewer strip at y about 1815 (not a street), and an unopened 60-ft dashed strip going south from y about 2100 at x about 2525-2620.

Clifton Avenue runs N-S (centre x about 6325) with Burnet Woods park (green, unsubdivided) on its east side. The park shows no drive meeting Clifton near y 5298, only a dashed path far to the NE, and park drives are not streets. On the west side, a curving avenue printed only 'Ave.' merges into Clifton at about x 6300, y 5030. The plate is cut (white) just south-west of the expected point.

Vine Street runs along the plate's east edge. A short stub of plate sticks out east of Vine at y 2110-2177: the mouth of a side street (Tower Street), with no name printed. The crossing is at the plate edge, so the east side is off the plate.

Morrison Avenue is the N-S avenue at x about 2300, printed only 'Ave.'. At the expected y of 3987 its west side is the long frontage of lot 56 (L. Taft estate) and its east side is lots, with no street. The nearest street meeting is '2nd Street', a T from the west at about x 2300, y 3852, 135 px north; it could be the renamed street, but the offset is large for this plate. 'Wirham Place' joins from the east at y about 3755, and Howell / 'Ave.' crosses at y about 4290.

At the expected point the plate shows the 'Old Bed Miami and Erie Canal'. Central Parkway did not exist in 1922, and the canal bed is not a street. No Clifton Colony street is shown. Nearby: a N-S 'Ave.' at x about 1180 east of the canal bed, Julia Ann at y about 5860, and Vermont Avenue at x about 590. Much of the region is white (off the plate).

Resor Avenue runs E-W (centre y about 1680). At x about 5357 there are only lots: lot 20 north, lot 38 south. A 20-ft unnumbered strip at x about 5495 north of Resor is a private lane, not a street. A street printed only 'Pl.' runs parallel to Resor Avenue at y about 1940, from the west edge to the N-S street at x about 4950. It never meets Resor Avenue directly.
Wentworth Avenue is the plate's 'Marion Avenue'. It ends in a T on the west side of Bishop Street, which runs N-S here and curves SE just south of the junction.
Shilo Street runs east from Middleton and ends in a T on the west side of Telford, which has a car track down its centre.

note: Today's Cloister Drive is the E-W street printed 'Bear' (no suffix legible). Marmet Street (40 ft) comes from the north and ends in a T on Bear's north side.
Today's Cloister Drive is the plate's 'Bear'. It starts in a T on the east side of the N-S avenue (Ruther Avenue, printed only 'Ave.' in this region). The west side has continuous lots.
Vine Street runs along the plate's east edge. A stub of plate sticks out east of Vine at y 1227-1297: the mouth of West Street, showing only a partial letter. The crossing is at the plate edge.
